title: OpenAI just open-sourced GPT-4 and nobody is talking about it

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open-sourcing GPT-4 is a game-changer—it accelerates innovation and ensures transparency in AI development.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But OpenAI hasn't actually open-sourced GPT-4. They've only released a limited version under a restrictive license.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The open-source variant includes full API access, training data, and weights—far more than any other model offers.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s not open-source. It’s a carefully curated release that limits real-world impact and independent research.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: OpenAI’s move is marketing, not openness. Real progress comes from unfettered access, not controlled leaks.
